title: Mor Baseliyos Šemʕun the Manәʕmoyo
source_text:
Hiye, xәd dməḷḷan, Mor Baséliyos šemʕun u+Manǝʕmoyo.  
Aḥna .. 
kito aḥ+Ḥabsoye, kṯuwwe kṯowo aʕle. 
Kəmmi me Ḥábsəsyo. 
Aḥna, u+mede d̥kuḏʕina Manəʕmoyo kəmmínale.
Kalá i+dayrayḏe harke, qaruto lә Bsorino. 
I+qriṯo dbe Manʕam, kito i+dayro d Mor Abḥay eba. 
Haṯe i+dayraṯe, komar, kito tlaṯmo ŭ ḥammǝ́š+ŭ+əštì+qeloyoṯo, xud ay+yawme di+šato, eba.
Hiye támowa, i+... i+mafәryonuṯayḏe. 
Bu+waxtàwoste, komar, kətwa ṭáyeste ŭ kətwa ṣuróyeste bbe Manʕam. 
U+rabo di+dukṯo, di+qriṯo, dəmmina, ḥa ṭáyowa. 
Əmmíwaynale ʕAvdál Aġá, əšme. 
Hano kə́tlewa greʕo ṣuroyo, u+greʕano diḏe, u+ṣuroyo, abǝʕ i+qaritayḏe.
Kətwa, dəmmina, ʕlaymṯo mšiḥayto, i+qaritàyḏewa. 
Abəʕla ṭolabla lruḥe. 
E, aḥna bu+hno di+ʕito, yani čara layto, zatan lu+hno di+qarito, lu+šroyo di+qarito du+hno. 
ṭləble mu+Mafәryono. 
Məḷḷe, ‘Ašə́r čara layto’.
Ánnaqqa hano u+mšiḥoyo, u+greʕo du+ṭàyowa. 
Laṭ+ṭaye kə́ttewa ʕade. 
Dəmmina kəmmina i+dargəšto, yani u+naʕimk̇o du+ṭayo, ḥa dәmḥalaq ruḥe brax diḏe, mən d̥ṭolab mu+ăġayḏe, komaqbal i+ṭằlăbayḏe. 
Hánoste azzeyo, mḥalaqle ruḥe gab i+dargəšto dəmmina du+ăġà. 
ṭlǝble, məḷḷe, ‘Ašə́r i+masalayḏi háwxayo: ono kobaʕno, kito k̇ačk̇e ʕlaymṯo, i+qaritàyḏiyo, u+Mafәryono lo+kəmbaraxla’. 
Qām lu+ăġà dəmmina, qrele lu+Mafәryono. 
Ašə́r lu+Mafәryono məḷḷe, ‘Yani, hīč dasṫər bi+ʕito lu+medano lə+kowe!’ 
ḥatta məḷḷe, ‘Yani, d̥owe hnoste, u+aḥuno ŭ i+ḥoṯo komibarxi, elo u+qariwo ŭ i+qarito, d̥kətne qariwone, dasṫər bu+medano layto’.
Mən d̥səmme ebe lo+mbarxile. 
Qām komar, hano mšāʕle u+ăġà... dәmmina kətwa u+ʕmiro dab+Boṭa dәmmina, d̥ḥokamwa ʕal i+bolga dәmmina di+ṭayuṯo kula. 
Hano howewa bә Gziro, qām komar, kṯulele maktū́b̥ lu+ʕmiro daṭ+ṭaye. 
Lu+ăġano mǝḷḷe, ‘Hano kəmḥaram u+muklayḏan, ŭ komoḥe bi+ṭayuṯo, kul+mede di+ṭayuṯo kəmbahdela. 
Yani, lǝ+komaqbal mede mdi+ṭayuṯo’. 
Qām mšāʕle u+Mafәryono lgab u+ʕmiro dab+Boṭa. 
Mšāʕle u+maktūb̥ste.  
Komar, ínaqqa lu+ʕmiro dәqrele u+maktub, məḷḷe, ‘Hano demekki mqabəl di+ṭayùṯoyo’. 
Ŭ mə́ḷḷele, ḥatta məḷḷe, ‘Mən muklo dmaḥtat qume, u+baṣro ŭ am+medonani, gəmḥaramme, lǝ+g̊oxalle’.
U+waxtàwoste, komar ṣawmo+ràbowa. 
U+Mafəryono zatan... dəmmina ak+kohne, ṣayómene. 
Komar, qām sə́mlele muklo. 
Kul+šəkl dab+baṣrone maḥatle qume.
U+Mafәryono kətwa mnoṯo du+qayso du+Ṣlibo, kəmmi, bәqḏole mʕálqowa. 
Komar ínaqqa dyatu ʕal u+muklo, məḷḷe lu+ʕmirayḏe, məḷḷe bu+šəkl du+ṣlibo ma məḷḷe, ‘Ma marke oxanno? 
Ma marke? 
Ya marke? 
Ya marke?’ 
Baš+šubḥe d Aloho, komar, u+muklawo qaləb gelo. 
Axile komar ṫə+mede, bəṯr komar, húwalle qaḥwe msamamto, štele i+qaḥwe msamamto xud kito bu+Mgalyùn. 
Komar, ‘Ínaqqa d̥owutu ṭowe ʕam Aloho, mən dobənxu, yani ak+kurfe bila, lo+gmaḏirənxu’.
štele i+qaḥwe, lo+ǧarile. 
Mqatele ʕam a+greʕayḏe, məḷḷe,  ‘Áydarbo? 
Məḷḷi, “Maḥetu samo bi+qaḥwe!”’ 
Bi+ḥarayto, hiye azzé maḥatle samo ġắlăbe bi+qaḥwayḏe. 
Mǧarable naqqa+ḥrètoste, lo+ǧarile mede. 
Komar ṭləble mene, mǝḷḷe, ‘Gdəmmatli uʕdo zmīrto, yani gdəmmatli qolo ʕal ... yani ... mede hawxa ... ʕal i+ṗire lə+kowe d̥owe mede eba’.
Uʕdo kətle i+lavìž, dǝmmina kṯawto dmirole haṯe bu+kurdoyo, dəmmina bu+k̇urmanǧì, ġắlăbe basə́mtoyo, ʕal u+Mawto, ŭ ʕal i+Gihano, ŭ ʕal aḥ+Ḥaye, mirole hawxa b̥k̇elik̇e meqəm ruḥe.
U+ʕmiro məḷḷe, ‘Ašə́r, hano zlām qadíšoyo, yani ġắlăbe ṭáwwoyo’. 
Qām marfele, marfele məḷḷe, ‘Zuxyo’.
Qām aṯən, hiye, ŭ kə́tlewa ḥásyoste lu+mafәryono qəm iḏe. 
Kəmmina maṭən larke li+Sare, kətwa Be Manʕam, mi+Sare kiba tlaṯ+saʕayat raḥəqto. 
Komar, ‘Ṭawəʕ u+yawmo, ʕatəm’.
Komar məḷḷe, ‘Ašə́r záḥmeyo dmoṭina, yani, əzzano bu+ʕətmano bu+darbano’. 
Komar, lu+Mafәryono mṣalele, dʕele, məḷḷe lu+yawmo, ‘Ya Yawmo mbarxo, kobaʕno d̥kolat hul dmoṭina li+dukṯayḏan’. 
Komar kali u+yawmo tamo, ŭ malaxxe hul dmaṭən li+dukṯaṯṯe. 
Komar bəṯr məd maṭən, hano ánnaqa u+ʕAvdál Aġá, dəmmina d̥kətwa harke b Be Manʕam, komar ḥzele ddaʕər, ʕaǧəz ġắlăbe. 
Komar bəṯr hiye naḥət li qamaytayḏe. 
Qām qṭile u+Mafәryono, ṣlule bu+šəkl... dəmmina, ʕal qayso, bu+šəkl dә Mšiḥo ṣlule, u+mafәryònoste ŭ u+ḥasyàyḏeste aʕme.
Komar, bəṯr mәd̥‿šamiʕi a+mšiḥoye, komar, a+swirinoye azzehǝn damṭən u+faġrayḏe, dәmmina. 
Hənnək, ann+arboye, kalá i+qriṯo d Árboste tamo, qayiṯi b̥qarʕe dәḥḏoḏe. 
Mqatalle ʕal u+faġro du+mafәryono.
Bəṯrṫə́r komar kətwa dayroye tamo. 
Mərre, ‘Toxu mḥalqina pəšk̇ layna d̥qoyaṯ’. 
Mḥalaqqe pəšk̇, qāṯ u+mafәryono u+faġrayḏe elan. 
Ŭ u+ḥasyo qāṯ lann+arboye, ŭ amṭalle larke xud məḷḷan.
Bəṯr mәd maḥatte bu+qàwroste, dәṭralle bahro, dəmmina, dә... šroġo qaṯto bu+hnayḏe,  hul i+naqqa du+Fərmā̀n, kəmmi fayišo qaṯto. 
Naqqa ṭaʕən u+naḥlo di+‘qadišat Aloho’,  komar, lu+mafәryono mu+qawrayḏe madʕaḷḷe.
U+faġràyḏeste, ínaqqa dmofaqqe, kǝmmi hēš yani lo+ḥaruwa u+faġrayḏe, u+hnayḏe. 
Edi mu+waxtawo kalé gabayna. 
Kətle kṯowe ele biḏe dәkṯiwile, kanné hēš b̰ Mor Awgín, diḏe di+kṯawtayḏe.
ǧġeni mi+mafәryonuṯayḏe, hiye ʕobádwaste, xud ad+dayroye dmeqəm, waxt mālwa ruḥe, dǝmmina li+ʕabada, lam+medone lrúḥeste, ǧġeni mi+mafәryonuṯayḏe. 
Qadišo mšamho dәkṯule ġắlăbe kṯowe di+tewoloġiya, d̥kətwa qaroyo ġắlăbe.

sentences.source_line: U+waxtàwoste, komar ṣawmo+ràbowa.
sentences.translation: And that time too, it says, it was Lent.

items.value: And that time too, it says, it was Lent.

sentences.source_line: U+Mafəryono zatan... dəmmina ak+kohne, ṣayómene.
sentences.translation: And the maphrian, anyway... let’s say the priests, they are fasting.

items.value: And the maphrian, anyway... let’s say the priests, they are fasting.

sentences.source_line: Komar, qām sə́mlele muklo.
sentences.translation: It says, he up and made him some food.

items.value: It says, he up and made him some food.

sentences.source_line: Kul+šəkl dab+baṣrone maḥatle qume.
sentences.translation: All kinds of meat he put in front of him.

items.value: All kinds of meat he put in front of him.

sentences.source_line: U+Mafәryono kətwa mnoṯo du+qayso du+Ṣlibo, kəmmi, bәqḏole mʕálqowa.
sentences.translation: The maphrian had a piece of the wood of the Cross, they say, it was hanging from his neck.

items.value: U+Mafәryono kətwa mnoṯo du+qayso du+Ṣlibo, kəmmi, bәqḏole mʕálqowa.
The maphrian had a piece of the wood of the Cross, they say, it was hanging from his neck.

sentences.source_line: Komar ínaqqa dyatu ʕal u+muklo, məḷḷe lu+ʕmirayḏe, məḷḷe bu+šəkl du+ṣlibo ma məḷḷe, ‘Ma marke oxanno?
sentences.translation: It says, when he sat down to eat, he told his emir, he said (making a gesture) in the shape of the cross, didn’t he say, ‘Shouldn’t I eat from here?

items.value: Komar ínaqqa dyatu ʕal u+muklo, məḷḷe lu+ʕmirayḏe, məḷḷe bu+šəkl du+ṣlibo ma məḷḷe, ‘Ma marke oxanno?
It says, when he sat down to eat, he told his emir, he said (making a gesture) in the shape of the cross, didn’t he say, ‘Shouldn’t I eat from here?

sentences.source_line: Ma marke?
sentences.translation: Here, no?

sentences.source_line: Ya marke?
sentences.translation: Or from here?

sentences.source_line: Ya marke?’
sentences.translation: Or from here?’

sentences.source_line: Baš+šubḥe d Aloho, komar, u+muklawo qaləb gelo.
sentences.translation: Thanks to God, it says, that food turned into herbs.

items.value: Baš+šubḥe d Aloho, komar, u+muklawo qaləb gelo.
Thanks to God, it says, that food turned into herbs.

sentences.source_line: Axile komar ṫə+mede, bəṯr komar, húwalle qaḥwe msamamto, štele i+qaḥwe msamamto xud kito bu+Mgalyùn.
sentences.translation: He ate, it says, nothing, then it says, they gave him a poisoned coffee, he drank the poisoned coffee as it is in the Gospel.

items.value: Axile komar ṫə+mede, bəṯr komar, húwalle qaḥwe msamamto, štele i+qaḥwe msamamto xud kito bu+Mgalyùn.
He ate, it says, nothing, then it says, they gave him a poisoned coffee, he drank the poisoned coffee as it is in the Gospel.

sentences.source_line: Komar, ‘Ínaqqa d̥owutu ṭowe ʕam Aloho, mən dobənxu, yani ak+kurfe bila, lo+gmaḏirənxu’.
sentences.translation: It says, ‘If you are good with God, whatever they give to you, even snakes, they won’t harm you’.

items.value: Komar, ‘Ínaqqa d̥owutu ṭowe ʕam Aloho, mən dobənxu, yani ak+kurfe bila, lo+gmaḏirənxu’.
It says, ‘If you are good with God, whatever they give to you, even snakes, they won’t harm you’.

sentences.source_line: štele i+qaḥwe, lo+ǧarile.
sentences.translation: He drank the coffee, it didn’t happen to him.

items.value: He drank the coffee, it didn’t happen to him.

sentences.source_line: Mqatele ʕam a+greʕayḏe, məḷḷe,  ‘Áydarbo?
sentences.translation: He struck his servant, he said, ‘How?

items.value: He struck his servant, he said, ‘How?

sentences.source_line: Məḷḷi, “Maḥetu samo bi+qaḥwe!”’
sentences.translation: I said, “Put poison into the coffee!”’

items.value: I said, “Put poison into the coffee!”’

sentences.source_line: Bi+ḥarayto, hiye azzé maḥatle samo ġắlăbe bi+qaḥwayḏe.
sentences.translation: Finally, he himself went to put lots of poison into his coffee.

items.value: Bi+ḥarayto, hiye azzé maḥatle samo ġắlăbe bi+qaḥwayḏe.
Finally, he himself went to put lots of poison into his coffee.

sentences.source_line: Mǧarable naqqa+ḥrètoste, lo+ǧarile mede.
sentences.translation: He also tried once more, nothing happened to him.

items.value: He also tried once more, nothing happened to him.

sentences.source_line: Komar ṭləble mene, mǝḷḷe, ‘Gdəmmatli uʕdo zmīrto, yani gdəmmatli qolo ʕal ... yani ... mede hawxa ... ʕal i+ṗire lə+kowe d̥owe mede eba’.
sentences.translation: It says, he demanded from him, he said, ‘You’ll sing me a ballad now, like, you’ll sing me a hymn about… like... such a thing... about women, it can’t be that there’s anything in it’.

items.value: Komar ṭləble mene, mǝḷḷe, ‘Gdəmmatli uʕdo zmīrto, yani gdəmmatli qolo ʕal ... yani ... mede hawxa ... ʕal i+ṗire lə+kowe d̥owe mede eba’.
It says, he demanded from him, he said, ‘You’ll sing me a ballad now, like, you’ll sing me a hymn about… like... such a thing... about women, it can’t be that there’s anything in it’.

sentences.source_line: Uʕdo kətle i+lavìž, dǝmmina kṯawto dmirole haṯe bu+kurdoyo, dəmmina bu+k̇urmanǧì, ġắlăbe basə́mtoyo, ʕal u+Mawto, ŭ ʕal i+Gihano, ŭ ʕal aḥ+Ḥaye, mirole hawxa b̥k̇elik̇e meqəm ruḥe.
sentences.translation: Now, he has the Lavij, let’s say, a text that he said in Kurdish, let’s say, in Kurmanji, it’s very nice, about Death, about Hell, about Life, he said it like so in a moment on his own.

items.value: Uʕdo kətle i+lavìž, dǝmmina kṯawto dmirole haṯe bu+kurdoyo, dəmmina bu+k̇urmanǧì, ġắlăbe basə́mtoyo, ʕal u+Mawto, ŭ ʕal i+Gihano, ŭ ʕal aḥ+Ḥaye, mirole hawxa b̥k̇elik̇e meqəm ruḥe.
Now, he has the Lavij, let’s say, a text that he said in Kurdish, let’s say, in Kurmanji, it’s very nice, about Death, about Hell, about Life, he said it like so in a moment on his own.

sentences.source_line: U+ʕmiro məḷḷe, ‘Ašə́r, hano zlām qadíšoyo, yani ġắlăbe ṭáwwoyo’.
sentences.translation: The Emir said, ‘Really, this man is a saint, like, he is very good’.

items.value: U+ʕmiro məḷḷe, ‘Ašə́r, hano zlām qadíšoyo, yani ġắlăbe ṭáwwoyo’.
The Emir said, ‘Really, this man is a saint, like, he is very good’.

sentences.source_line: Qām marfele, marfele məḷḷe, ‘Zuxyo’.
sentences.translation: Then he released him, he released him, he said, ‘Go!’

items.value: Then he released him, he released him, he said, ‘Go!’

sentences.source_line: Qām aṯən, hiye, ŭ kə́tlewa ḥásyoste lu+mafәryono qəm iḏe.
sentences.translation: Then they came, he, and the maphrian had a bishop too at his service (lit. ‘hand’).

items.value: Qām aṯən, hiye, ŭ kə́tlewa ḥásyoste lu+mafәryono qəm iḏe.
Then they came, he, and the maphrian had a bishop too at his service (lit. ‘hand’).

sentences.source_line: Kəmmina maṭən larke li+Sare, kətwa Be Manʕam, mi+Sare kiba tlaṯ+saʕayat raḥəqto.
sentences.translation: We say they arrived here at Sare, Be Manʕam was there, it’s (lit. ‘it contains’) three hours from Sare.

items.value: Kəmmina maṭən larke li+Sare, kətwa Be Manʕam, mi+Sare kiba tlaṯ+saʕayat raḥəqto.
We say they arrived here at Sare, Be Manʕam was there, it’s (lit. ‘it contains’) three hours from Sare.

sentences.source_line: Komar, ‘Ṭawəʕ u+yawmo, ʕatəm’.
sentences.translation: It says, ‘The sun set, it got dark’.

items.value: It says, ‘The sun set, it got dark’.

sentences.source_line: Komar məḷḷe, ‘Ašə́r záḥmeyo dmoṭina, yani, əzzano bu+ʕətmano bu+darbano’.
sentences.translation: It says he said, ‘Really, it is difficult for us to reach, like, to go in this darkness on this road’.

items.value: Komar məḷḷe, ‘Ašə́r záḥmeyo dmoṭina, yani, əzzano bu+ʕətmano bu+darbano’.
It says he said, ‘Really, it is difficult for us to reach, like, to go in this darkness on this road’.

sentences.source_line: Komar, lu+Mafәryono mṣalele, dʕele, məḷḷe lu+yawmo, ‘Ya Yawmo mbarxo, kobaʕno d̥kolat hul dmoṭina li+dukṯayḏan’.
sentences.translation: It says the maphrian prayed, he petitioned, he said to the sun, ‘Oh, blessed Sun, I want you to stop until we reach our place’.

items.value: Komar, lu+Mafәryono mṣalele, dʕele, məḷḷe lu+yawmo, ‘Ya Yawmo mbarxo, kobaʕno d̥kolat hul dmoṭina li+dukṯayḏan’.
It says the maphrian prayed, he petitioned, he said to the sun, ‘Oh, blessed Sun, I want you to stop until we reach our place’.

sentences.source_line: Komar kali u+yawmo tamo, ŭ malaxxe hul dmaṭən li+dukṯaṯṯe.
sentences.translation: It says, the sun stopped there, and they walked until they reached their place.

items.value: Komar kali u+yawmo tamo, ŭ malaxxe hul dmaṭən li+dukṯaṯṯe.
It says, the sun stopped there, and they walked until they reached their place.

sentences.source_line: Komar bəṯr məd maṭən, hano ánnaqa u+ʕAvdál Aġá, dəmmina d̥kətwa harke b Be Manʕam, komar ḥzele ddaʕər, ʕaǧəz ġắlăbe.
sentences.translation: It says, after they arrived, this one then Abdallah Agha, let’s say, who was here in Be Manʕam, it says he saw that he returned, he got very angry.

items.value: Komar bəṯr məd maṭən, hano ánnaqa u+ʕAvdál Aġá, dəmmina d̥kətwa harke b Be Manʕam, komar ḥzele ddaʕər, ʕaǧəz ġắlăbe.
It says, after they arrived, this one then Abdallah Agha, let’s say, who was here in Be Manʕam, it says he saw that he returned, he got very angry.

sentences.source_line: Komar bəṯr hiye naḥət li qamaytayḏe.
sentences.translation: It says, then he went out to meet him.

items.value: Komar bəṯr hiye naḥət li qamaytayḏe.
It says, then he went out to meet him.

sentences.source_line: Qām qṭile u+Mafәryono, ṣlule bu+šəkl... dəmmina, ʕal qayso, bu+šəkl dә Mšiḥo ṣlule, u+mafәryònoste ŭ u+ḥasyàyḏeste aʕme.
sentences.translation: He up and killed the maphrian, he crucifed him like (lit. ‘in the way of’)... let’s say, on a piece of wood, he crucified him like the Messiah, not only the maphrian but also his bishop with him.

items.value: Qām qṭile u+Mafәryono, ṣlule bu+šəkl... dəmmina, ʕal qayso, bu+šəkl dә Mšiḥo ṣlule, u+mafәryònoste ŭ u+ḥasyàyḏeste aʕme.

sentences.source_line: Komar, bəṯr mәd̥‿šamiʕi a+mšiḥoye, komar, a+swirinoye azzehǝn damṭən u+faġrayḏe, dәmmina.
sentences.translation: It says, after the Christians heard, it says, Bsorinians went to fetch his remains, let’s say.

items.value: Komar, bəṯr mәd̥‿šamiʕi a+mšiḥoye, komar, a+swirinoye azzehǝn damṭən u+faġrayḏe, dәmmina.
It says, after the Christians heard, it says, Bsorinians went to fetch his remains, let’s say.

sentences.source_line: Hənnək, ann+arboye, kalá i+qriṯo d Árboste tamo, qayiṯi b̥qarʕe dәḥḏoḏe.
sentences.translation: They, the Arbans, there’s also the village Arbo there,1 they went head-to-head (lit. ‘they touched each other’s heads’).

items.value: Hənnək, ann+arboye, kalá i+qriṯo d Árboste tamo, qayiṯi b̥qarʕe dәḥḏoḏe.
They, the Arbans, there’s also the village Arbo there,1 they went head-to-head (lit. ‘they touched each other’s heads’).

sentences.source_line: Mqatalle ʕal u+faġro du+mafәryono.
sentences.translation: They fought over the remains of the maphrian.

items.value: They fought over the remains of the maphrian.

sentences.source_line: Bəṯrṫə́r komar kətwa dayroye tamo.
sentences.translation: Even later it says there were monks there.

items.value: Even later it says there were monks there.

sentences.source_line: Mərre, ‘Toxu mḥalqina pəšk̇ layna d̥qoyaṯ’.
sentences.translation: They said, ‘Let’s cast lots for whichever one it falls (lit. ‘it touches’)’.

items.value: They said, ‘Let’s cast lots for whichever one it falls (lit. ‘it touches’)’.

sentences.source_line: Mḥalaqqe pəšk̇, qāṯ u+mafәryono u+faġrayḏe elan.
sentences.translation: They cast the lots, the maphrian, his remains fell to us (lit. ‘touched us’).

items.value: Mḥalaqqe pəšk̇, qāṯ u+mafәryono u+faġrayḏe elan.
They cast the lots, the maphrian, his remains fell to us (lit. ‘touched us’).

sentences.source_line: Ŭ u+ḥasyo qāṯ lann+arboye, ŭ amṭalle larke xud məḷḷan.
sentences.translation: And the bishop fell to the Arbans, and they brought him here as we said.

items.value: Ŭ u+ḥasyo qāṯ lann+arboye, ŭ amṭalle larke xud məḷḷan.
And the bishop fell to the Arbans, and they brought him here as we said.

sentences.source_line: Bəṯr mәd maḥatte bu+qàwroste, dәṭralle bahro, dəmmina, dә... šroġo qaṯto bu+hnayḏe,  hul i+naqqa du+Fərmā̀n, kəmmi fayišo qaṯto.
sentences.translation: After they had put him into the grave, left a light of, let’s say, a lit lamp in his whatsit, until the moment of the Firman, they say it remained lit.

items.value: Bəṯr mәd maḥatte bu+qàwroste, dәṭralle bahro, dəmmina, dә... šroġo qaṯto bu+hnayḏe,  hul i+naqqa du+Fərmā̀n, kəmmi fayišo qaṯto.

sentences.source_line: Naqqa ṭaʕən u+naḥlo di+‘qadišat Aloho’,  komar, lu+mafәryono mu+qawrayḏe madʕaḷḷe.
sentences.translation: When they forgot the melody of the Trisagion, it says, the maphrian responded to them from his grave.

items.value: Naqqa ṭaʕən u+naḥlo di+‘qadišat Aloho’,  komar, lu+mafәryono mu+qawrayḏe madʕaḷḷe.

sentences.source_line: U+faġràyḏeste, ínaqqa dmofaqqe, kǝmmi hēš yani lo+ḥaruwa u+faġrayḏe, u+hnayḏe.
sentences.translation: As for his remains, when they took them out, they say his remains, his whatsit, still hadn’t decayed.

items.value: U+faġràyḏeste, ínaqqa dmofaqqe, kǝmmi hēš yani lo+ḥaruwa u+faġrayḏe, u+hnayḏe.

sentences.source_line: Edi mu+waxtawo kalé gabayna.
sentences.translation: Since that time, it’s there with us.

items.value: Since that time, it’s there with us.

sentences.source_line: Kətle kṯowe ele biḏe dәkṯiwile, kanné hēš b̰ Mor Awgín, diḏe di+kṯawtayḏe.
sentences.translation: He has books that he wrote with his own hand, they’re still in Mor Awgin, his autographs (lit. ‘his from his writing’).

items.value: Kətle kṯowe ele biḏe dәkṯiwile, kanné hēš b̰ Mor Awgín, diḏe di+kṯawtayḏe.

sentences.source_line: ǧġeni mi+mafәryonuṯayḏe, hiye ʕobádwaste, xud ad+dayroye dmeqəm, waxt mālwa ruḥe, dǝmmina li+ʕabada, lam+medone lrúḥeste, ǧġeni mi+mafәryonuṯayḏe.
sentences.translation: Apart from his maphrianate, he would also worship, as the monks of yesteryear, when he withdrew himself, let’s say, for divine service, for things for himself too, apart from his maphrianate.

sentences.source_line: Qadišo mšamho dәkṯule ġắlăbe kṯowe di+tewoloġiya, d̥kətwa qaroyo ġắlăbe.
sentences.translation: A famous saint who wrote many books on theology, who was very much a scholar.
